text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
New Year's resolutions, huh. I see, I see. 
In other words...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So we're just making noise for the sake of 
it, huh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Wait, no! I almost got swept up 
in the momentum.

—New Year's resolutions. With the turn of 
the year bringing the Classic Year, I 
decided to set new goals for the months 
ahead.
choice_data_list:
Have you already decided on a goal, Nice 
Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Me? Well, yeah, more or less.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My New Year's resolution is— To have a 
match with Teio.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a spar...? Nature, you're gonna race 
Teio!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Honestly, I feel intimidated, but 
I can't keep running away forever just 
because my opponent is out of this world. 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna find out with these legs early 
this year! Even if it means crashing and 
burning!

Nice Nature seemed to have steeled her 
resolve. Indeed, as members of the same 
generation—

She's a rival I'll have to clash with 
eventually. If I want to reach the top in 
the Classic tier, I just have to steel my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Nature has really grooown 
up, hasn't she? Mhm, mhm.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aren't we acting mighty high and mighty... 
So Turbo, what's your resolution? What are 
you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Um, Turbo's resolution is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just saying it is boring, so let's do 
kakizome—first calligraphy of the year!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, first calligraphy of the year...? Do 
we really have to use a brush?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Turbo's got great handwriting! I'm 
gonna write it super neat and sharp!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, got any good ideas? A goal 
that'll get Turbo fired up!

"...They left the whole decision to me. 
Though it might be nice to propose 
something that fits just right."

The goal I want Twin Turbo to accomplish 
this year is—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
""Defeat Teio," huh? Yeah, we can't just 
leave it all to Nature."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
After all, Teio's lifelong rival is Turbo! 
Alright, that's what I'll write down!

Twin Turbo quickly set to work with her 
brush.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how's this? Turned out pretty well, 
right?
The words written there were—
"Defeat Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Not 'overthrow', but 'appropriate'...? 
Wait, isn't this kanji wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer. Let's go ahead and 
a-chieve our goals!
—Tokai Teio was at the arcade. And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Let's battle! I'll take you on in 
any game you want!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really? Then let's do the dance game!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait... A dance game...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay! No-miss clear, perfect! I'm super 
good at this~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu, I couldn't even clear the first 
stage~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, it starts from here! Practice, 
practice! And in the end, I'll wiiiin!!

The outcome of the match was truly a case 
of 'as expected of Teio.' Even so, Twin 
Turbo fought desperately and showed her 
sheer determination.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Beware of colds," huh? Yeah, staying 
healthy is important!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then that's what I'll write!

Twin Turbo quickly set to work with her 
brush.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how's this? Turned out pretty well, 
right?
The words written there were—
"Beware of wind"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not a cold, just the wind...? Wait, aren't 
you missing a word here?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer. Let's go ahead and 
a-chieve our goals!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I-It's pretty cold today, isn't it...? 
Staying outside might give me a cold...
choice_data_list:
Then it might be best not to go outside 
too much.

Then it might be best not to go outside 
too much.

text_block_list.text:
If it literally means "Beware of the 
wind", then one must not be exposed to 
cold drafts. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, during New Year's we're hanging 
out at Trainer's room. Let's play video 
games, games!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm hungry~. I wanna eat 
something~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trea-ts, trea-ts!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grooooar, grooooar...!! *mumble* 
*mumble*... Turbo full throttleee...!

Twin Turbo took 'beware of the wind' to 
heart and spent the whole day holed up in 
her room. It seems she got a good rest.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"One good deed a day," huh? Yeah, maybe 
doing something nice this year wouldn't be 
so bad!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then that's what I'll write!

Twin Turbo quickly set to work with her 
brush.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how's this? Turned out pretty well, 
right?
The words written there were—
"One Full Out a Day"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"A complete good" instead of "a good 
deed"...? Wait, isn't this character 
written wrong?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer. Let's go ahead and 
a-chieve our goals!

After thinking it through from every 
angle, the place I brought Twin Turbo to 
was...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A manga cafe? Why are we in a place like 
this? Turbo, what should I do?
choice_data_list: Let's read the entire manga series today!

text_block_list.text:
If you read an entire series in a single 
day, you could call it a 'daily complete 
deed.'

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The whole series, huh~? In that case, 
maybe I'll read that. The racing manga 
I've been wanting to read for ages, 
"Racing Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo learned tons of stuff from 
manga! Like how driving behind another car 
makes you go faster!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, manga can be really 
educational too, right?! Let's try that 
next time.

Through "One Full Out a Day," Twin Turbo 
learned a variety of techniques. She might 
even be able to apply them in a race.
